annotations.text:
TEMBO E1 — concept electric utility pickup.
Double cab, dual motor, 250 mm clearance, 1 435 mm bed.

Drawings are 1:20 at 96 px/in. All specification figures are design-freeze targets for a concept, not homologated values.

Colourways and the HMI artboard have working controls — click a paint chip or a drive mode.
